description: Export Cloud DB for MSSQL server logs to Object Storage. Use ncloud_list_mssql_log_files to get available log files.

bucketName.description: Object Storage bucket name to export to

cloudMssqlExportObjectList.description: List of log objects to export

fullObjectName.description: Full object name of the log file to export

folderPath.description: Folder path within the bucket. If omitted, exports to bucket root.

name: ncloud_export_mssql_log
